authority: CBSE Class X curriculum PDFs supplied in ../Data/Curriculum-2026
notes: This is a reviewed retrieval map, not replacement educational source text.
Science Heredity is treated as examinable because the detailed curriculum lists it and the current sample paper assesses Mendelian inheritance; the broad final note remains ambiguous.
Formative material is mapped separately for future learning-only retrieval; it is not in the current approved year-end answer index.
Science curriculum page 6 excludes information in NCERT boxes from the year-end examination; boxed text requires separate exclusion during source review.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations
topics.scope: Chemical reactions, chemical equations, balanced chemical equations, combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement, precipitation, endothermic and exothermic reactions, oxidation and reduction.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Acids, Bases and Salts
topics.scope: Acids and bases, indicators, chemical properties, neutralisation, pH and its everyday importance, sodium hydroxide, bleaching powder, baking soda, washing soda and plaster of Paris.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Metals and Non-metals
topics.scope: Properties of metals and non-metals, reactivity series, ionic compounds, basic metallurgical processes, corrosion and prevention.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Carbon and its Compounds
topics.scope: Covalent compounds, hydrocarbons, homologous series, nomenclature, functional groups, combustion, oxidation, addition, substitution, ethanol, ethanoic acid, soaps and detergents.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Life Processes
topics.scope: Nutrition, respiration, transport and excretion in plants and animals.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Control and Coordination
topics.scope: Plant tropic movements and hormones; animal nervous system, voluntary, involuntary and reflex actions, and animal hormones.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: How do Organisms Reproduce?
topics.scope: Asexual and sexual reproduction in animals and plants, reproductive health, family planning, safe sex, HIV/AIDS, child bearing and women's health.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Heredity
topics.scope: Heredity, Mendel's contribution and laws of inheritance, and brief sex determination. Evolution sections are formative only.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Light — Reflection and Refraction
topics.scope: Spherical mirrors and lenses, images, mirror and lens formulae without derivation, magnification, refraction, refractive index and power of a lens.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
topics.scope: Human eye lens and vision defects, prism, dispersion and scattering; colour of the sun at sunrise and sunset is excluded.
excludedTerms: colour of the sun at sunrise
color of the sun at sunrise
colour of the sun at sunset
color of the sun at sunset

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Electricity
topics.scope: Current, potential difference, Ohm's law, resistance and resistivity, series and parallel resistors, heating effect, power and relations between P, V, I and R.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
topics.scope: Magnetic field and field lines, field from conductor, coil or solenoid, force on conductor, Fleming’s left-hand rule, AC/DC, AC frequency and advantage of AC over DC, and domestic circuits. Motor, electromagnetic induction and electric generator are formative only.

topics.subject: science
topics.title: Our Environment
topics.scope: Ecosystems, environmental problems, ozone depletion, waste and solutions, biodegradable and non-biodegradable substances.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Real Numbers
topics.scope: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and proofs of irrationality of square roots 2, 3 and 5 and related expressions such as 3 + 2√5.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Polynomials
topics.scope: Zeroes of a polynomial and relationship between zeroes and coefficients of quadratic polynomials.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
topics.scope: Graphical solution and consistency, number of solutions, substitution and elimination, and simple situational problems.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Quadratic Equations
topics.scope: Standard form, real roots by factorisation or quadratic formula, discriminant and nature of roots, and situational problems.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Arithmetic Progressions
topics.scope: Nth term and sum of first n terms of an arithmetic progression and daily life applications.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Triangles
topics.scope: Similarity of triangles, proof of the Basic Proportionality Theorem, statement without proof of its converse and the similarity criteria, and applications.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Coordinate Geometry
topics.scope: Distance formula and section formula for internal division.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Introduction to Trigonometry
topics.scope: Trigonometric ratios at the standard angles 0, 30, 45, 60 and 90 degrees where defined, relationships and simple identities based on sin squared A plus cos squared A equals 1.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Some Applications of Trigonometry
topics.scope: Simple heights and distances with at most two right triangles and elevation or depression angles limited to 30, 45 and 60 degrees.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Circles
topics.scope: Tangent perpendicular to radius at point of contact and equal tangents from an external point, proofs and applications.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Areas Related to Circles
topics.scope: Areas and perimeters of sectors and segments; segment central angles limited to 60, 90 and 120 degrees.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Surface Areas and Volumes
topics.scope: Surface areas and volumes of combinations of any two cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, cylinders or cones.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Statistics
topics.scope: Mean, median and mode of grouped data; avoid bimodal situations.

topics.subject: maths
topics.title: Probability
topics.scope: Classical definition of probability and simple probability of an event.

formativeTopics.subject: science
formativeTopics.title: Electric motor, electromagnetic induction and electric generator
